desc:
PREORDER - PRODUCTSHIPS IN 4 WEEKS

The Vakarian has been designed with the armed and responsible citizen in mind. It comes with everything you need to simply insert your gear & armor and start training. Fully adjustable in almost every way possible and coming complete with shoulder pads, single stage placard, 5.56 & 7.62 inserts, tourniquet holder, elastic cummerbund with retention, plate bags, Micro RIG H-Harness with waist Strap and Micro Rig Adapter.

The Vakarian is a true 4 -in-1 package that comes ready out of the box so you don’t need to buy any other Nylon product to get yourself LARPing ASAP! Whether you’re here on earth or maybe on some crime infested space station on a asteroid in the far reaches of the galaxy. Also Yüs, the Multicam is legit.

The Vakarian has the Reach and Flexibility to accomplish any mission.

-500D Nylon Construction
-Durable WJ Buckles (there’s a bunch of them)
-Complete Front and Back Plate Bags
-Retention Cummerbund
-2 x Adjustable Shoulder pads with pass throughs
-Single stage Adjustable placard with Laser Cut MOLLE field
-1 x 5.56 Elastic 3 Mag Insert
-1 x 7.62 Elastic 2 Mag Insert
-Elastic Torniquet Pouch
-H - Harness
-Standalone Waist Strap
-Ready Rig Conversion Attachment
-Velcro delete panel
-Made In Vietnam so it will love you long time
